description: This Java class defines a Gradle task 'GenerateWordsListFromAOSPTask' that processes AOSP words-list files (possibly compressed) to generate a word list XML file. It includes methods for reading input files, parsing word data lines with regex, and writing the output, with configurable parameters for input/output files and maximum words.

classes.name: GenerateWordsListFromAOSPTask
classes.description: A Gradle task class that reads an AOSP words list file (possibly compressed), parses it with regex, and generates a word list XML file, with configurable input/output files and maximum word count.

methods.name: generateWordsList
methods.description: Main task action method that reads the input file, handles compression, parses each line with regex, and writes words to output until reaching the maximum word limit.

methods.name: getInputFile
methods.description: Getter for the input file to be processed.

methods.name: getOutputWordsListFile
methods.description: Getter for the output file where the word list will be written.

methods.name: getMaxWordsInList
methods.description: Getter for the maximum number of words to process.

methods.name: setMaxWordsInList
methods.description: Setter for the maximum number of words to process.
